Meeting notes: Fairmont site visit, October 20

Attendees: Bauer, Lindqvist, and Osei from our side; Mr. Takahashi and Ms. Cole for Fairmont.

Fairmont confirmed the loading dock can take 53-foot trailers, which removes the need for the smaller fleet we priced in September. They asked for deliveries between 06:00 and 09:00 to avoid the shift change.

Open items: Cole will send the insurance certificate by October 30, and Bauer will revise the quote to reflect the larger trailers. Next call is November 4 at 14:00.

labels.notes: Many bare surnames; none are errors.
